items.raw_excerpt: It's likely you've already chewed and swallowed some tasty morsel today. But when did that ability emerge? New evidence points to at least the middle Jurassic, back when dinosaurs still reigned.
items.summary_en: Scientists found a fossil of a small, platypus-like mammal. It is from the middle Jurassic, when dinosaurs lived. The fossil shows this animal could chew and swallow its food.
items.summary_ko: 과학자들이 오리너구리를 닮은 작은 포유류 화석을 찾았어요. 이 화석은 공룡이 살던 중기 쥐라기 시대의 것이에요. 이 동물이 음식을 씹고 삼킬 수 있었다는 사실을 보여줍니다.
items.title_en: Old mammal fossil shows when chewing began
items.title_ko: 아주 오래된 포유류 화석, 씹는 능력의 시작을 보여줘
items.title_original: This surprising mammal fossil is giving scientists something to chew on
